title: ジュニアカップにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Junior Cup. Our success here is essential if we want to move on to the coveted Classics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan, determined to discard her naivety and become stronger, heads into the race.
